crossRefs.note: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and…
and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a…
For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that…
But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how…
Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…
Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

translations.web: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
translations.bsb: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
translations.kjv: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
translations.asv: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.
